# OpenDocBot

> OpenDocBot is a privacy-first, zero-proxy Microsoft Office Add-in for Word and Excel that connects directly to AI providers.

## Key Features
- Zero-Proxy Architecture: Direct client-to-LLM communication without intermediary servers.
- Privacy-First: No telemetry, no client tracking, local storage for API keys.
- Multi-Model: Supports Ollama (local LLMs), OpenAI, DeepSeek, Anthropic, Gemini, OpenRouter, OpenCode Zen, and other OpenAI-compatible endpoints.
